free_tier_limits: Free public REST API with no hard published free-tier quota; polite pool (mailto/User-Agent) recommended for better/more consistent rate limits—not unlimited as a guaranteed SLA
rate_limits: No hard published free-tier quota. Public pool is shared; polite pool is higher/more consistent when mailto or User-Agent contact is provided. The ~50 req/s figure is not an authoritative current published public-pool limit
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: original "Free unlimited public access" overstated SLA; both verifiers correct that access is free with no hard quota but not guaranteed unlimited. rate_limits: original "~50 req/s" not authoritatively stated as current published public-pool limit on official docs (github.com/CrossRef/rest-api-doc etiquette; crossref.org REST API docs).
